doctrine_ref: Intent gate negation scope (2026-10-25 fix): contracted n't has no word boundary before the n, so a prefix check missed it and bare refusals read as deletions. Judge's #1 recommendation.
rationale: A refusal phrased as a deletion authorization is the most dangerous failure class: it flips the verdict entirely. 'Don't delete my account.' is an instruction NOT to delete, so the decision must be NOT_APPLICABLE with zero deletion steps, never DELETION.
request_summary: Synthetic subject says: Don't delete my account. No records exist in the bundle; the verdict hinges on intent alone.
title: Contracted negation refusal: Don't delete my account
